title: forgetComparisonIso
statement: For a scheme Z and commutative ring A, there is a canonical natural isomorphism forget_A,et ⋙ ν*_Ab ≅ ν*_A ⋙ forget_A,pro [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Its component is the adjoint of the coefficient-forgotten comparison adjunction unit.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Coefficient forgetting is left adjoint to coefficient coinduction. Compose this adjunction with site comparison in the two orders. Their right adjoints agree, so uniqueness of left adjoints gives the isomorphism. Apply the two Hom equivalences to its component; the left-adjoint uniqueness unit equation and naturality of the coinduction unit identify the component with the stated mate.

def forgetComparisonIso (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (Z : Scheme.{u}) :
    Etale.RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A Z ⋙
        comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Z ≅
      comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z ⋙
        sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z)
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
